additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434328 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
AT
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Please Refer below troubleshooting steps for your reference:
1.Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
2.Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
3.Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers (
2102312VGQKXN8000151
) and verify if they are powered on.
4.Swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on. Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.
